시편 132:1.content: A Song of degrees. Lord, remember David, and all his afflictions:

시편 132:2.content: How he sware unto the Lord, and vowed unto the mighty God of Jacob;

시편 132:3.content: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;

시편 132:4.content: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, or slumber to mine eyelids,

시편 132:5.content: Until I find out a place for the Lord, an habitation for the mighty God of Jacob.

시편 132:6.content: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.

시편 132:7.content: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.

시편 132:8.content: Arise, O Lord, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.

시편 132:9.content: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.

시편 132:10.content: For thy servant David’s sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.

시편 132:11.content: The Lord hath sworn in truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.

시편 132:12.content: If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.

시편 132:13.content: For the Lord hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his habitation.

시편 132:14.content: This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.

시편 132:15.content: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.

시편 132:16.content: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

시편 132:17.content: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.

시편 132:18.content: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.
